title: A Home for Everyone
text:
Many people in big cities do not have enough money for a home. Rent is high, and some families must move far from their jobs. Some cities now give help to people with low incomes. This help can be a small apartment or money for rent.

Anna is a nurse in Madrid. Last year she could not pay her rent, so she asked the city for help. The city gave her a place to live for six months. Now she saves money every month and hopes to find her own home again.

questions.text: What do some cities give to people with low incomes?
options: A small apartment or money for rent

questions.text: Why did Anna ask the city for help?
options: She wanted to move to a new country
She could not pay her rent

questions.text: What can the reader infer about why some families must move far from their jobs?
options: Jobs are always near their homes
Homes near work are often too expensive
They do not like to work
The city forces them to move

questions.text: What is the main message of the passage?
options: Housing help can support people who struggle to pay for a home
Nurses should not live in big cities
Big cities have no problems with housing
Rent is always low in big cities

vocabulary.definition: money that a person pays regularly to live in a home that belongs to someone else
a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building
a person whose job is to care for sick people
support that someone gives to another person who needs it

paragraph_translations: Muchas personas en las grandes ciudades no tienen suficiente dinero para una casa. El alquiler es alto, y algunas familias deben mudarse lejos de su trabajo. Algunas ciudades ahora ofrecen ayuda a personas con ingresos bajos. Esta ayuda puede ser un pequeño apartamento o dinero para el alquiler.

Anna es enfermera en Madrid. El año pasado no pudo pagar su alquiler, así que pidió ayuda a la ciudad. La ciudad le dio un lugar para vivir durante seis meses. Ahora ahorra dinero cada mes y espera encontrar otra vez su propia casa.
